d:
Bina hari sabzi ke Soya Pav Bhaji! Soya ki smell hatao, dahi se swad badhao — protein se bharpur, ghar par hi banao.
Soya chunks aur soya chura dono se Soya Pav Bhaji banana
Nimbu ke saath ubaal kar soya ki smell hatane ka tarika
Dahi wala pav bhaji masala aur halwai jaisi bhunai
Kam tel mein banane ki trick aur pav bhaji style serving
Comment karein — aap Soya Pav Bhaji pav ke saath khayenge ya jeera rice ke saath?
